---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
```

The Bond films in this dataset range from `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` to `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.

## Bond Revenue Overtime
```{python}
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
